onboarding.screennameDescription: This is how you'll show up across Pana MIA — on your profile, on anything you post, and anywhere people find you. You can skip for now, but you'll need one before you can post or follow.
onboarding.welcomeBody: One last thing before you look around: pick the name people will know you by. It takes a few seconds, and it's what lets you post, follow, and be found.
onboarding.nameHint: Optional. How you'd like to be introduced.
onboarding.screennameHint: 3–24 characters. Letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens.
onboarding.screennameCooldown: Choose carefully — you can change it again after 90 days.
onboarding.privacyNote: Your name and screenname are public. Your email stays private.
onboarding.skipCost: You can look around without one, but you won't be able to post or follow until you pick a screenname.
onboarding.checkFailed: Could not check that name. Try again.
onboarding.setFailed: Could not save that screenname. Try again.
onboarding.finishSetupHint: Pick a screenname to post and follow
onboarding.startTitle: Where do you want to start?
onboarding.startBody: You're @{{screenname}} now. All of this stays open to you — this is just the quickest way in.
onboarding.startDirectoryBody: Find the makers, shops, and artists around you.
onboarding.startSocialBody: Pana Social is the community timeline. Post, follow, reply.
onboarding.startBusinessBody: Run a shop, a studio, or a stand? Get listed so people can find you.
onboarding.startSkip: I'll find my own way around
onboarding.identityBodyBoth: Add your name and a photo so panas know who they're talking to.
onboarding.identityBodyName: Add your name so panas see more than a handle.
onboarding.identityBodyAvatar: Add a photo so panas can put a face to your posts.
